To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of Coq for knowledge representation and reasoning allows to overcome the limitations of OWL-DL and SWRL and to provide a formalization of the problem of underground networks detection that is more precise and more complete than the current state of the art.

• We propose a new approach to the problem of reliable underground networks geo-detection using knowledge-based reasoning, • We show that the OWL-DL ontology language is not powerful enough for our purpose and that a type theoretical language is more suitable, • We show how to use the Coq theorem prover for the formalization and the proof of our approach, • We show on a real world case study how the proposed approach works and its limitations.
(1) the use of Coq for the detection of underground networks is a promising approach; (2) this approach is not yet mature and requires further research.

the development of a formal framework that can be used for the detection of underground networks.
